name: @avatark/invitations
description: Shared, framework-agnostic invitation contract -- ArenaK produces invitations, every other AvatarK product (Echo, StreamK, GameK, CinemaK, future ones) consumes them through this same typed boundary.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
